outputs.explanation: Panel A shows super-resolution reconstruction images (localizations, density map, 3D localizations, cluster segmentation) — micrograph/reconstruction images, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel B shows super-resolution reconstruction images for PacL2-mEos, analogous to panel A — not a plot.
Scatter/dot plot of number of clusters per cell shows individual gray dots (per-cell values) with mean ± SEM overlaid, per caption.
Scatter/dot plot of cluster sizes shows individual gray dots (per-cluster values) with mean ± SEM overlaid, per caption.
Scatter/dot plot of proportion of clustered molecules per cell shows individual gray dots with mean ± SEM overlaid, per caption.
Panel F shows super-resolution reconstruction/trajectory images, not a summary plot.

Panel G contains a histogram of diffusion coefficients and a mean-square-displacement line plot (multiple individual traces shown); neither is a bar/mean plot requiring overlaid individual points — histograms and line plots are exempt.
Panel H shows trajectory maps and a kymograph, which are image-based visualizations rather than averaged summary plots.
